passages.heading: Debt note
passages.text: 19. Borrowings All borrowings are initially recorded at fair value, net of transaction costs. Borrowings are subsequently carried at amortised cost, with the difference between the proceeds, net of transaction costs, and the amount due on redemption being recognised as a charge to the income statement over the period of the relevant borrowing. ​ Lease liabilities The corresponding liability to the lessor is recognised as a lease obligation within short term and long-term borrowings. The carrying amount is subsequently increased to reflect interest on the lease liability and reduced by lease payments made. ​ For calculating the discounted lease liability on leases, the implicit rate in the lease is used. If this is not available, the incremental borrowing rate with a lease-specific adjustment is used. Finance costs are charged to the income statement to produce a constant periodic rate of charge on the remaining balance of the obligations for each accounting period. ​ Variable rents are not part of the lease liability and the right of use asset. These payments are charged to the income statement as incurred. Short term and low-value leases are not capitalised, and lease rentals are also charged to the income statement as incurred. ​

passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: The Group has identified a broad range of risks relating to its business and the industry in which it operates. These risks are described below and, together with all other information contained in this Annual Report, should be carefully considered in evaluating the Group. The risks and uncertainties described below represent those we consider to be material as at the date of this Annual Report, with material risks being those to which senior management pay particular attention and which could cause the delivery of the Group’s strategy, financial condition, results of operations and/or prospects to differ materially from expectations. However, these risks and uncertainties are not the only ones facing the Group. If any of the following risks occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also impair our business operations. Risks relating to the Group’s business and industry The Group operates in a highly competitive market The Group faces substantial and increasing competition in all of its product categories and geographic markets. There are relatively low barriers to entry in certain product categories in many of the markets in which the Group operates (particularly in the VMS category) and accordingly the Group’s businesses compete with companies of all sizes on many different fronts, including cost-effectiveness, product effectiveness and quality, brand recognition and loyalty, technological innovations, consumer convenience, promotional activities, new product introductions and expansion into new markets and channels. The Group expects to continue to see heightened activity from its competitors worldwide, including: (i) increasing and aggressive competition from smaller, high-growth companies which often operate on a regional basis, and may disrupt existing route-to-market models; (ii) increasing competition from multinational corporations moving for the first time into, or expanding or focusing their presence (whether through acquisitions, disposals, demergers or other means) in the global consumer healthcare market; (iii) continuing competition from private label products, which are brands sold exclusively by a particular retailer; and (iv) an increase in the introduction and aggressive marketing of new products in high-demand healthcare areas. Some of the Group’s competitors may conduct more effective advertising and promotion activities than the Group does, introduce competing products more quickly and/or respond more effectively to business and economic conditions and changing consumer preferences, including by launching innovative new products. These risks could also be enhanced by the relatively recent development of generative AI and its rapidly evolving nature, which could enable new or existing competitors who are better able to capitalise on these developments to achieve additional competitive advantages, such as enhanced product targeting or cost-savings on advertising and promotion. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow covers gross interest expense several times over, and free cash flow after capital expenditure remains substantial, giving the group ample internal liquidity to fund its borrowings. Cash conversion is steady across the disclosed trend, with operating cash flow rising while reported debt declined, which supports the intermediate financial risk profile.

Operating margin sits well above the consumer staples sector median, reflecting the pricing power of the group's consumer healthcare brands. Revenue has drifted lower across the disclosed trend, but operating income and operating cash flow both improved, indicating cost discipline and mix benefits rather than volume-led growth.

key_risks.text: The risk factors describe a highly competitive market with relatively low barriers to entry, particularly in the VMS category, and aggressive competition from smaller high-growth companies, multinational entrants, private label and generative AI-enabled rivals. This could pressure pricing, promotional spend and route-to-market economics, weakening the cash generation that currently underpins leverage headroom.

The debt note confirms that lease liabilities are recognised within short-term and long-term borrowings, so reported borrowings include lease obligations and finance costs accrue on those balances. As leases roll and incremental borrowing rates reset, interest expense could rise even without new debt issuance, compressing coverage from its current level.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is comfortable and broadly in line with the sector median, while free cash flow to debt sits above the sector median, indicating the group can service borrowings from internally generated funds. Net leverage is modestly above the sector median but remains below the threshold that would signal a weaker cash-flow tier.

The current ratio is marginally below the sector median and below one, meaning current liabilities exceed current assets. This is not a liquidity concern given strong operating cash flow, but it does mean near-term maturities and lease payments rely on continued cash generation rather than balance-sheet liquidity.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is intermediate, with leverage in the second tier and cash-flow coverage also in the second tier. Headroom to the next leverage threshold is limited, so a modest EBITDA decline or debt increase could shift the profile, while an upgrade would require meaningful deleveraging or cash-flow improvement.

Our forward view is that the group can sustain investment-grade-like debt service metrics if operating cash flow holds near current levels and capital expenditure stays modest. The main uncertainties are competitive pressure on revenue and the interest cost embedded in lease-inclusive borrowings, both of which could erode coverage over time.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流覆蓋總利息支出數倍以上，而扣除資本開支後之自由現金流仍然可觀，令集團擁有充裕的內部流動性為其借款提供資金。現金轉換在披露趨勢中保持穩定，營運現金流上升而呈報債務下降，支持中等財務風險狀況。
營運利潤率遠高於消費必需品行業中位數，反映集團消費者保健品牌的定價能力。收入在披露趨勢中有所下滑，但營運收入及營運現金流均有所改善，顯示成本紀律及產品組合效益，而非銷量帶動的增長。

key_risks.text: 風險因素描述了一個競爭激烈、進入門檻相對較低的市場，尤其在 VMS 類別，並面臨來自小型高增長公司、跨國新進入者、自有品牌及生成式人工智能驅動對手的激烈競爭。這可能對定價、促銷支出及市場推廣經濟效益構成壓力，削弱目前支撐槓桿緩衝的現金產生能力。
債務附註確認租賃負債於短期及長期借款中確認，因此呈報借款包括租賃義務，而融資成本按該等結餘計提。隨著租賃續期及增量借款利率重設，即使沒有新債務發行，利息支出亦可能上升，令覆蓋率從目前水平受壓。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率充裕，與行業中位數大致相符，而自由現金流對債務比率高於行業中位數，顯示集團可從內部產生資金償還借款。淨槓桿略高於行業中位數，但仍低於預示現金流層級較弱的門檻。
流動比率略低於行業中位數且低於一，意味流動負債超過流動資產。鑑於營運現金流強勁，這並非流動性憂慮，但確實意味短期到期債務及租賃付款依賴持續現金產生，而非資產負債表流動性。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為中等，槓桿處於第二層級，現金流覆蓋亦處於第二層級。距離下一槓桿門檻的緩衝有限，因此 EBITDA 適度下降或債務增加可能改變該狀況，而評級上調則需要有意義的去槓桿或現金流改善。
我們的前瞻觀點是，若營運現金流維持在目前水平附近且資本開支保持溫和，集團可維持類投資級的債務償還指標。主要不確定性在於收入面臨的競爭壓力，以及包含租賃的借款所隱含的利息成本，兩者均可能隨時間侵蝕覆蓋率。
